# Security policy

## Supported versions

Ox Tuner is experimental and has no release. Only the latest commit on `main`
is supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through GitHub's [private vulnerability
reporting](https://github.com/brilliantnz/ox-tuner/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue.

Include what you did, what happened, and the version or commit you ran. Remove
personal data, project files and ECU data from anything you attach.

A report about a write, burn or read-back path takes priority over everything
else: a wrong byte in a tune can damage an engine.
